## HAAS Alert Achieves SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 Certifications for 2024

Jan 16, 2025

SHARE

[![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69a702d83c162df7b511fc26_facebook.svg)](https://haasalert.com/news/soc-2-type-2-iso-27001-2024#) [![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69a702d838408bb4d10d71d2_linkedin.svg)](https://haasalert.com/news/soc-2-type-2-iso-27001-2024#) [![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69a75bbb0bc783124efa7226_x-purple.svg)](https://haasalert.com/news/soc-2-type-2-iso-27001-2024#) [![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65ba9670d732a9fcbfe647cf/69a75bd8cb84dbaa64766d7f_icon-share-purple.svg)](https://haasalert.com/news/soc-2-type-2-iso-27001-2024#)

We’re excited to announce that HAAS Alert has achieved ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type 2 security compliance!

ISO 27001 is an internationally recognized standard that demonstrates  our commitment to maintaining the highest level of information security management. By adhering to rigorous security protocols, we ensure that sensitive data is protected, risks are managed effectively, and continuous improvements are made to safeguard our systems and infrastructure. This milestone reinforces our dedication to providing our partners and clients with the confidence that their information is in trusted hands.

Similarly, achieving SOC 2 Type 2 compliance highlights our commitment to maintaining the highest standards of data security. The SOC 2 Type 2 audit confirms that our security controls are rigorously designed and consistently operating to protect the confidentiality and integrity of our clients' sensitive information. This milestone underscores our ongoing dedication to safeguarding data and ensuring that our systems remain secure and resilient against potential threats.

Achieving both ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type 2 security compliance provides HAAS Alert with more than just reports and badges on our website. It is a strong demonstration of our ongoing vow to protect your data. We deeply value our customers’ privacy. ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 allow us to constantly streamline our controls and processes, allowing us to make security improvements that continue to provide you with a secure and enjoyable experience with HAAS Alert.

HAAS Alert continues to prioritize data security and regulatory compliance. We pride ourselves in remaining steadfast in upholding the highest standards of excellence in security and all aspects of our operations.

Thank you to our partners and stakeholders in this journey for their support as we continue on towards greater security and compliance.

Take a look at [our privacy policy](https://www.haasalert.com/privacy) to learn more about HAAS Alert’s efforts to protect your information.
